"""Survey-gated Native capture for distinct statutory qualifier contexts."""
import argparse
from contextlib import ExitStack
import json
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess

from geometry import CROSSWALK_RECT
from qualifier_geometry import TARGET_X, check as geometry_check, open_drive
from qualifier_context import (QUALIFIERS, authority_row, device_row, find_device,
                               spawn_direction_participant,
                               spawn_traffic_actor, traffic_command, traffic_row,
                               write_context_manifest)

FRAMES = 600
RATE = 20
CAMERAS = (
    ('overview', 1920, 1080, 0, -19, 25, -45),
    ('approach', 1280, 720, 3, -15, 14, -35),
    ('reference_corner', 1280, 720, -20, -15, 14, -35),
    ('driver_reference', 1280, 720, -5, -10, 9, -25),
)


def control_for(case, index, distance, speed):
    """Engineering motion intent only; legal stop/stand/park is source reviewed."""
    throttle = .28 if distance > 9 else (.11 if distance > 4 else 0.0)
    brake = 0.0 if distance > 4 else (1.0 if distance < 2 else .35)
    return {'throttle': throttle, 'brake': brake,
            'hand_brake': distance < 2 and speed < .1}


def check():
    g = geometry_check()
    if len(CAMERAS) != 4 or len({c[0] for c in CAMERAS}) != 4 or FRAMES / RATE != 30:
        raise ValueError('four independent camera streams and 30-second capture required')
    return {'passed': True, 'frames': FRAMES, 'rate_hz': RATE,
            'camera_names': [c[0] for c in CAMERAS], 'targets': TARGET_X,
            'geometry': g, 'native_imported': False, 'physical_acceptance_claimed': False}


def survey(world, carla):
    mapping = world.get_map()
    out = []
    for x in (-30, -14, -5, 3, 30):
        loc = carla.Location(x=x, y=-5.0, z=8.4)
        wp = mapping.get_waypoint(loc, project_to_road=True, lane_type=carla.LaneType.Parking)
        if wp is None or wp.road_id != 1 or wp.lane_id != -2:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Native parking lane readback failed at x={x}')
        at = wp.transform.location
        if abs(at.x - x) > 1 or abs(at.y + 5.0) > 1 or abs(at.z - 8) > 1:
            raise RuntimeError(f'Native parking geometry readback failed at x={x}')
        out.append({'requested_x_m': x, 'native_xyz_m': [at.x, at.y, at.z],
                    'road_id': wp.road_id, 'lane_id': wp.lane_id, 'lane_type': str(wp.lane_type)})
    return out


def survey_crosswalk(world):
    points = world.get_map().get_crosswalks()
    near = [[p.x, p.y, p.z] for p in points if -2 <= p.x <= 6 and -8.5 <= p.y <= 2]
    if len(near) < 4:
        raise RuntimeError('Native marked-crosswalk geometry readback missing')
    xs, ys = [p[0] for p in near], [p[1] for p in near]
    if (abs(min(xs) - CROSSWALK_RECT[0]) > .5 or
            abs(max(xs) - CROSSWALK_RECT[1]) > .5 or
            abs(min(ys) - CROSSWALK_RECT[2]) > .5 or
            abs(max(ys) - CROSSWALK_RECT[3]) > .5):
        raise RuntimeError('Native crosswalk extent differs from distance reference')
    return near


def execute(output_dir, case, host, port):
    import carla
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore

    check()
    if case not in TARGET_X:
        raise ValueError('unknown crosswalk parking case')
    output = Path(output_dir).resolve()
    if any((output / name).exists() for name in (
            'video_frames.jsonl', 'vehicle-poses.jsonl', 'traffic-actors.jsonl',
            'device-states.jsonl', 'authority-events.jsonl')):
        raise ValueError('original Native attempt already has frame sources')
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(180)
    saved = snapshot(client)
    old = client.get_world()
    if saved['settings'].synchronous_mode or any(a.type_id.startswith(
            ('vehicle.', 'walker.', 'sensor.', 'controller.')) for a in old.get_actors()):
        raise RuntimeError('requires an exclusive idle asynchronous Native world')
    owned, encoders, queues = [], {}, {}
    changed = False
    try:
        world = client.generate_opendrive_world(open_drive(case), carla.OpendriveGenerationParameters(
            vertex_distance=.5, max_road_length=25, wall_height=0, additional_width=0,
            smooth_junctions=False, enable_mesh_visibility=True,
            enable_pedestrian_navigation=False))
        changed = True
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 1 / RATE
        settings.substepping = True
        settings.max_substep_delta_time = .01
        settings.max_substeps = 10
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        readback = survey(world, carla)
        crosswalk_readback = survey_crosswalk(world)
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (output / 'road.xodr').write_text(world.get_map().to_opendrive())
        inventory = {'assignment_id': 'training__C229397__LVMC-11-52-130-A12__motor_vehicle_driver',
                          'source_kind': 'native_saved_sample', 'native_readback': readback,
                          'native_crosswalk_readback': crosswalk_readback,
                          'crosswalk_rect_xyxy_m': CROSSWALK_RECT,
                          'crosswalk_road_object_id': '1',
                          'jurisdiction_source_id': None,
                          'marked_crosswalk_source_id': None,
                          'crosswalk_extent_source_id': 'Native map.get_crosswalks and road.xodr',
                          'responsible_person_source_id': None,
                          'traffic_conflict_review_source_id': None,
                          'law_compliance_review_source_id': None,
                          'directions_review_source_id': None,
                          'qualifier': QUALIFIERS[case],
                          'source_status': 'Native proposed geometry only; marking and qualifier authority need original source review'}
        (output / 'crosswalk-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2) + '\n')
        bp = sorted(world.get_blueprint_library().filter('vehicle.*'), key=lambda b: b.id)[0]
        bp.set_attribute('role_name', 'c229397_parking_subject')
        vehicle = world.spawn_actor(bp, carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=-38, y=-5.0, z=8.8), carla.Rotation(yaw=0)))
        owned.append(vehicle)
        traffic_actor = spawn_traffic_actor(world, carla, owned) if case == 'traffic_conflict_near' else None
        device = find_device(world) if case == 'device_direction_near' else None
        direction_participant = spawn_direction_participant(world, carla, owned) if case == 'police_direction_near' else None
        context = write_context_manifest(output / 'qualifier-context.json', case, device)
        for name, width, height, x, y, z, pitch in CAMERAS:
            camera_bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find('sensor.camera.rgb')
            camera_bp.set_attribute('image_size_x', str(width))
            camera_bp.set_attribute('image_size_y', str(height))
            camera_bp.set_attribute('fov', '85')
            camera_bp.set_attribute('sensor_tick', str(1 / RATE))
            camera = world.spawn_actor(camera_bp, carla.Transform(
                carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z), carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch)))
            owned.append(camera)
            q = queue.Queue()
            camera.listen(q.put)
            queues[name] = q
            encoders[name] = subprocess.Popen([
                'ffmpeg', '-nostdin', '-hide_banner', '-loglevel', 'error', '-y',
                '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'bgra', '-s', f'{width}x{height}',
                '-r', str(RATE), '-i', '-', '-frames:v', str(FRAMES),
                '-c:v', 'ffv1', '-level', '1', str(output / (name + '.mkv'))],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        with ExitStack() as stack:
            frame_map = stack.enter_context(FrameMap(output / 'video_frames.jsonl'))
            poses = stack.enter_context((output / 'vehicle-poses.jsonl').open('x'))
            intent = stack.enter_context((output / 'control-intent.jsonl').open('x'))
            trace = stack.enter_context((output / 'trace.jsonl').open('x'))
            traffic_file = stack.enter_context((output / 'traffic-actors.jsonl').open('x')) if traffic_actor else None
            device_file = stack.enter_context((output / 'device-states.jsonl').open('x')) if case == 'device_direction_near' else None
            authority_file = stack.enter_context((output / 'authority-events.jsonl').open('x')) if case in ('law_compliance_near', 'police_direction_near') else None
            first_elapsed = None
            for index in range(FRAMES):
                location = vehicle.get_transform().location
                velocity = vehicle.get_velocity()
                distance = TARGET_X[case] - location.x
                # Engineering brake schedule only; actual parking is measured after capture.
                speed_before = (velocity.x**2 + velocity.y**2 + velocity.z**2)**.5
                command = control_for(case, index, distance, speed_before)
                vehicle.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(**command, steer=0))
                traffic_intent = traffic_command(traffic_actor, index, carla) if traffic_actor else None
                native_frame = world.tick()
                snap = world.get_snapshot()
                if snap.frame != native_frame:
                    raise RuntimeError('Native snapshot/frame identity differs')
                ts = snap.timestamp.elapsed_seconds
                if first_elapsed is None:
                    first_elapsed = ts
                elapsed = ts - first_elapsed
                transform = vehicle.get_transform()
                velocity = vehicle.get_velocity()
                bbox = vehicle.bounding_box.extent
                mapped = {}
                for name, q in queues.items():
                    image = q.get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame < native_frame:
                        image = q.get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame != native_frame:
                        raise RuntimeError(f'Original camera frame join failed: {name}')
                    encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data)
                    mapped[name] = image.frame
                frame_map.append(native_frame, elapsed, camera_native_frames=mapped)
                poses.write(json.dumps({'video_frame': index, 'native_frame': native_frame,
                    'time_s': elapsed, 'vehicle_id': vehicle.id,
                    'vehicle_xy_m': [transform.location.x, transform.location.y],
                    'yaw_rad': transform.rotation.yaw * 3.141592653589793 / 180,
                    'bbox_half_length_m': bbox.x, 'bbox_half_width_m': bbox.y,
                    'speed_mps': (velocity.x**2 + velocity.y**2 + velocity.z**2)**.5,
                    'native_elapsed_seconds': ts, 'blueprint_id': vehicle.type_id}) + '\n')
                intent.write(json.dumps({'video_frame': index, 'native_frame': native_frame,
                    'time_s': elapsed, 'vehicle_id': vehicle.id,
                    'engineering_action': case, 'applied_control': command}) + '\n')
                trace.write(json.dumps({'frame': native_frame, 'time_s': elapsed,
                    'position': {'x': transform.location.x, 'y': transform.location.y,
                                 'z': transform.location.z}, 'heading_deg': transform.rotation.yaw,
                    'speed_mps': (velocity.x**2 + velocity.y**2 + velocity.z**2)**.5}) + '\n')
                if traffic_file:
                    traffic_file.write(json.dumps(traffic_row(
                        traffic_actor, index, native_frame, elapsed, traffic_intent)) + '\n')
                if device_file:
                    device_file.write(json.dumps(device_row(device, index, native_frame, elapsed)) + '\n')
                if authority_file:
                    authority_file.write(json.dumps(authority_row(
                        direction_participant, index, native_frame, elapsed,
                        QUALIFIERS[case])) + '\n')
        for name, process in encoders.items():
            process.stdin.close()
            stderr = process.stderr.read()
            if process.wait(timeout=180) or not (output / (name + '.mkv')).is_file():
                raise RuntimeError(f'Original camera encoding failed: {name}: {stderr.decode()[-400:]}')
        return {'frames': FRAMES, 'camera_names': list(queues), 'native_survey': readback,
                'native_crosswalk_readback': crosswalk_readback,
                'qualifier_context': context, 'traffic_actor_captured': traffic_actor is not None,
                'device_state_captured': device is not None,
                'authority_timeline_captured': case in ('law_compliance_near', 'police_direction_near'),
                'officer_authority_verified': False,
                'marked_crosswalk_source_missing': True, 'physical_acceptance_claimed': False,
                'legal_verdict_claimed': False}
    finally:
        for process in encoders.values():
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.kill()
                process.wait()
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            try:
                if hasattr(actor, 'stop'):
                    actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if changed:
            restore(client, saved)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--output-dir')
    parser.add_argument('--case', choices=list(TARGET_X))
    parser.add_argument('--host', default='127.0.0.1')
    parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps(check()))
    else:
        if not args.output_dir:
            raise SystemExit('--output-dir required for Native execution')
        case = args.case or json.loads(Path('config.json').read_text())['crosswalk_case']
        print(json.dumps(execute(args.output_dir, case, args.host, args.port)))

"""Authored road and crosswalk extent; painted marking needs Native review."""
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

CROSSWALK_RECT = [0.0, 4.0, -6.5, 0.0]
TARGET_X = {'controlled_1': -14.0, 'controlled_2': -5.0,
            'boundary_20ft': -8.096, 'stop_near': -5.0,
            'stand_near': -5.0}


def open_drive():
    root = ET.Element('OpenDRIVE')
    ET.SubElement(root, 'header', revMajor='1', revMinor='4', name='C229397 crosswalk road',
                  version='1.00', date='2026-11-23', north='0', south='0', east='50', west='-50')
    road = ET.SubElement(root, 'road', id='1', name='paved-road-with-crosswalk', length='100', junction='-1')
    ET.SubElement(road, 'link')
    segment = ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, 'planView'), 'geometry',
                            s='0', x='-50', y='0', hdg='0', length='100')
    ET.SubElement(segment, 'line')
    ET.SubElement(ET.SubElement(road, 'elevationProfile'), 'elevation', s='0', a='8', b='0', c='0', d='0')
    lanes = ET.SubElement(road, 'lanes')
    ET.SubElement(lanes, 'laneOffset', s='0', a='0', b='0', c='0', d='0')
    section = ET.SubElement(lanes, 'laneSection', s='0')
    ET.SubElement(section, 'left')
    center = ET.SubElement(section, 'center')
    ET.SubElement(center, 'lane', id='0', type='none', level='false')
    right = ET.SubElement(section, 'right')
    for lane_id, kind, width in ((-1, 'driving', 3.5), (-2, 'parking', 3.0)):
        lane = ET.SubElement(right, 'lane', id=str(lane_id), type=kind, level='false')
        ET.SubElement(lane, 'width', sOffset='0', a=str(width), b='0', c='0', d='0')
        ET.SubElement(lane, 'roadMark', sOffset='0', type='solid', color='white', width='.10')
    objects = ET.SubElement(road, 'objects')
    ET.SubElement(objects, 'object', id='1', name='crosswalk-proposal', type='crosswalk',
                  s='50', t='-3.25', zOffset='0', hdg='0', roll='0', pitch='0',
                  length='4', width='6.5', height='0')
    ET.SubElement(road, 'signals')
    return ET.tostring(root, encoding='unicode')


def check():
    root = ET.fromstring(open_drive())
    road = root.find('road')
    lanes = road.findall('lanes/laneSection/right/lane')
    crosswalk = road.find('objects/object')
    if road.attrib['length'] != '100' or [(int(l.attrib['id']), l.attrib['type']) for l in lanes] != [(-1, 'driving'), (-2, 'parking')]:
        raise ValueError('road/parking lane inventory differs')
    if crosswalk.attrib['type'] != 'crosswalk' or crosswalk.attrib['s'] != '50' or crosswalk.attrib['length'] != '4':
        raise ValueError('crosswalk proposal differs')
    if not (TARGET_X['controlled_1'] < TARGET_X['boundary_20ft'] < TARGET_X['controlled_2']) or CROSSWALK_RECT != [0.0, 4.0, -6.5, 0.0]:
        raise ValueError('controlled crosswalk targets differ')
    return {'passed': True, 'crosswalk_rect_xyxy_m': CROSSWALK_RECT,
            'target_centers_x_m': TARGET_X, 'road_length_m': 100,
            'native_marking_observed': False, 'physical_acceptance_claimed': False}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(json.dumps(check(), sort_keys=True))

"""Saved-source crosswalk distance diagnostics; no legal distance convention chosen."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math

ASSIGNMENT = 'training__C229397__LVMC-11-52-130-A12__motor_vehicle_driver'
FRAMES = 600
RATE = 20
TWENTY_FEET_M = 6.096


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def finite(v):
    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and math.isfinite(v)


def body_corners(row):
    x, y = row['vehicle_xy_m']
    yaw, length, width = row['yaw_rad'], row['bbox_half_length_m'], row['bbox_half_width_m']
    require(all(finite(v) for v in (x, y, yaw, length, width)) and length > 0 and width > 0,
            'invalid original vehicle body')
    cs, sn = math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw)
    return [(x + u * cs - v * sn, y + u * sn + v * cs)
            for u, v in ((length, width), (length, -width), (-length, -width), (-length, width))]


def point_rect_distance(p, rect):
    x0, x1, y0, y1 = rect
    return math.hypot(max(x0 - p[0], 0, p[0] - x1), max(y0 - p[1], 0, p[1] - y1))


def point_segment_distance(p, a, b):
    vx, vy = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
    t = max(0, min(1, ((p[0] - a[0]) * vx + (p[1] - a[1]) * vy) / (vx * vx + vy * vy)))
    return math.dist(p, (a[0] + t * vx, a[1] + t * vy))


def body_rect_distance(corners, rect):
    x0, x1, y0, y1 = rect
    rectangle = [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
    # A rectangle corner can lie inside the vehicle while every edge and
    # vehicle corner remains away from the crosswalk boundary.
    def orientation(a, b, c):
        return (b[0] - a[0]) * (c[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (c[0] - a[0])

    def intersects(a, b, c, d):
        if (max(min(a[0], b[0]), min(c[0], d[0])) > min(max(a[0], b[0]), max(c[0], d[0])) or
                max(min(a[1], b[1]), min(c[1], d[1])) > min(max(a[1], b[1]), max(c[1], d[1]))):
            return False
        o1, o2 = orientation(a, b, c), orientation(a, b, d)
        o3, o4 = orientation(c, d, a), orientation(c, d, b)
        return o1 * o2 <= 0 and o3 * o4 <= 0

    def in_body(p):
        turns = [orientation(corners[i], corners[(i + 1) % 4], p) for i in range(4)]
        return all(t >= -1e-9 for t in turns) or all(t <= 1e-9 for t in turns)

    if any(in_body(p) for p in rectangle) or any(point_rect_distance(p, rect) == 0 for p in corners):
        return 0.0
    if any(intersects(corners[i], corners[(i + 1) % 4],
                      rectangle[j], rectangle[(j + 1) % 4])
           for i in range(4) for j in range(4)):
        return 0.0
    values = [point_rect_distance(p, rect) for p in corners]
    for p in rectangle:
        values.extend(point_segment_distance(p, corners[i], corners[(i + 1) % 4]) for i in range(4))
    return min(values)


def measure(packet_bytes: bytes, inventory_bytes: bytes):
    packet, inventory = json.loads(packet_bytes), json.loads(inventory_bytes)
    require(packet.get('assignment_id') == ASSIGNMENT == inventory.get('assignment_id'), 'assignment mismatch')
    kind = packet.get('source_kind')
    require(kind in ('synthetic_native_sample', 'native_saved_sample') and inventory.get('source_kind') == kind,
            'source kind mismatch')
    for key in ('jurisdiction_source_id', 'marked_crosswalk_source_id', 'crosswalk_extent_source_id',
                'responsible_person_source_id', 'traffic_conflict_review_source_id',
                'law_compliance_review_source_id', 'directions_review_source_id'):
        require(inventory.get(key), key + ' missing')
    rect = inventory.get('crosswalk_rect_xyxy_m')
    require(isinstance(rect, list) and len(rect) == 4 and all(finite(v) for v in rect)
            and rect[0] < rect[1] and rect[2] < rect[3], 'marked crosswalk extent missing')
    rows = packet.get('frames')
    require(isinstance(rows, list) and len(rows) == FRAMES, '600 original frames required')
    require([r.get('video_frame') for r in rows] == list(range(FRAMES)), 'missing or unordered video frames')
    require(all(finite(r.get('native_frame')) for r in rows) and
            all(rows[i]['native_frame'] < rows[i+1]['native_frame'] for i in range(FRAMES-1)),
            'nonmonotonic Native frame identity')
    require(all(finite(r.get('time_s')) and abs(r['time_s'] - i / RATE) < .005 for i, r in enumerate(rows)),
            'missing original 20 Hz timing')
    require(packet.get('vehicle_id') and all(r.get('vehicle_id') == packet['vehicle_id'] for r in rows),
            'subject identity changed')
    require(all(finite(r.get('speed_mps')) and r['speed_mps'] >= 0 for r in rows),
            'invalid original subject speed')
    centers = [point_rect_distance(r['vehicle_xy_m'], rect) for r in rows]
    bodies = [body_rect_distance(body_corners(r), rect) for r in rows]
    along = [rect[0] - max(p[0] for p in body_corners(r)) for r in rows]
    halt = [i for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r['speed_mps'] <= .1]
    halt_set = set(halt)
    spans = []
    start = None
    for i in range(FRAMES + 1):
        if i in halt_set and start is None:
            start = i
        elif i not in halt_set and start is not None:
            spans.append({'first_frame': start, 'last_frame_inclusive': i - 1,
                          'sampled_duration_s': (i - start) / RATE,
                          'minimum_body_distance_m': min(bodies[start:i]),
                          'maximum_body_distance_m': max(bodies[start:i])})
            start = None
    return {'format': 'c229397-saved-crosswalk-distance-diagnostic-v1',
            'assignment_id': ASSIGNMENT, 'source_kind': kind,
            'packet_sha256': hashlib.sha256(packet_bytes).hexdigest(),
            'inventory_sha256': hashlib.sha256(inventory_bytes).hexdigest(),
            'frame_count': FRAMES, 'duration_s': FRAMES / RATE,
            'marked_crosswalk_source_id': inventory['marked_crosswalk_source_id'],
            'crosswalk_extent_source_id': inventory['crosswalk_extent_source_id'],
            'crosswalk_rect_xyxy_m': rect,
            'halt_proxy_frames': halt,
            'halt_proxy_spans': spans,
            'center_to_crosswalk_m_by_frame': centers,
            'body_to_crosswalk_m_by_frame': bodies,
            'along_road_body_gap_m_by_frame': along,
            'halt_body_distance_below_20ft_frames': [i for i in halt if bodies[i] < TWENTY_FEET_M],
            'halt_center_distance_below_20ft_frames': [i for i in halt if centers[i] < TWENTY_FEET_M],
            'statutory_20_feet_m': TWENTY_FEET_M,
            'legal_result': None,
            'unresolved': ['statutory measurement convention and boundary meaning',
                           'whether crosswalk is actually marked', 'traffic-conflict exception',
                           'law, police and device direction exceptions', 'parking purpose',
                           'original Native and video pixel review']}

"""Fail-closed saved-only join and crosswalk distance diagnostic."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from crosswalk_measure import ASSIGNMENT, FRAMES, measure
from source_review import join

CAMERAS = ('overview', 'approach', 'reference_corner', 'driver_reference')


def _jsonl(path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def finalize(attempt):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    source_paths = [attempt / name for name in ('vehicle-poses.jsonl', 'video_frames.jsonl', 'crosswalk-inventory.json', 'control-intent.jsonl')]
    if not all(p.is_file() for p in source_paths):
        raise ValueError('required original saved source missing')
    poses = _jsonl(source_paths[0])
    frame_map = _jsonl(source_paths[1])
    controls = _jsonl(source_paths[3])
    if len(poses) != FRAMES or len(frame_map) != FRAMES or len(controls) != FRAMES:
        raise ValueError('600 original saved frames required')
    for i, (pose, frame, control) in enumerate(zip(poses, frame_map, controls)):
        if pose.get('video_frame') != i or frame.get('video_frame') != i or pose.get('native_frame') != frame.get('native_frame'):
            raise ValueError('original pose/frame-map identity join failed')
        if abs(pose.get('time_s', -1) - frame.get('time_s', -2)) > .005:
            raise ValueError('original pose/frame-map timing join failed')
        if (control.get('video_frame') != i or control.get('native_frame') != pose['native_frame'] or
                control.get('vehicle_id') != pose.get('vehicle_id') or
                abs(control.get('time_s', -1) - pose['time_s']) > .005):
            raise ValueError('original control/pose identity join failed')
        camera_frames = frame.get('camera_native_frames')
        if not isinstance(camera_frames, dict) or set(camera_frames) != set(CAMERAS) or any(camera_frames[name] != pose['native_frame'] for name in CAMERAS):
            raise ValueError('four original camera identities missing or mismatched')
    packet = {'assignment_id': ASSIGNMENT, 'source_kind': 'native_saved_sample',
              'vehicle_id': poses[0]['vehicle_id'], 'frames': poses}
    packet_bytes = json.dumps(packet, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
    inventory, review_sha, review_findings = join(attempt, json.loads(source_paths[2].read_bytes()))
    diagnostic = measure(packet_bytes, json.dumps(inventory, sort_keys=True).encode())
    diagnostic['original_source_sha256'] = {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in source_paths}
    diagnostic['independent_source_review_sha256'] = review_sha
    diagnostic['independent_source_review_findings'] = review_findings
    diagnostic['camera_frame_map_validated'] = True
    diagnostic['engineering_action'] = controls[0].get('engineering_action')
    diagnostic['control_frame_join_validated'] = True
    diagnostic['video_pixels_decoded'] = False
    return diagnostic


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--attempt', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(finalize(args.attempt), sort_keys=True))

"""Saved-only source join and Native result writer for crosswalk cases."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from finalize_crosswalk import finalize as diagnose
from qualifier_source_audit import audit as audit_qualifier


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def measure_crosswalk_position(diagnostic, sources):
    frames = diagnostic['halt_proxy_frames']
    if not frames:
        raise ValueError('Original stopped interval missing')
    return {'value': {'minimum_body_gap_m': min(diagnostic['body_to_crosswalk_m_by_frame'][i] for i in frames),
                      'minimum_center_gap_m': min(diagnostic['center_to_crosswalk_m_by_frame'][i] for i in frames),
                      'sampled_halt_spans': diagnostic['halt_proxy_spans'],
                      'statutory_20_feet_m': diagnostic['statutory_20_feet_m'],
                      'legal_result': None},
            'method': 'measure_crosswalk_position', 'sources': sources}


def measure_qualifier_context(review, sources):
    return {'value': {'qualifier': review['qualifier'],
                      'finding': review['finding'],
                      'source_frame_count': review['source_frame_count']},
            'method': 'measure_qualifier_context', 'sources': sources}


def finalize(attempt, output):
    from worker_exchange.native_output import write_result

    attempt, output = Path(attempt).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    if output.exists() or (attempt / 'result.json').exists():
        raise ValueError('Retain prior analysis report or result')
    config = json.loads((attempt / 'config.json').read_text())
    case_id = config['case_id']
    if config.get('selected_case_id') != case_id or config.get('rate_hz') != 20 or config.get('duration_s') != 30:
        raise ValueError('Exact case capture contract differs')
    source_names = ('vehicle-poses.jsonl', 'control-intent.jsonl', 'video_frames.jsonl',
                    'crosswalk-inventory.json', 'crosswalk-source-review.json',
                    'qualifier-context.json', 'authority-events.jsonl', 'qualifier-source-packet.json')
    for name in (*source_names, 'trace.jsonl'):
        if not (attempt / name).is_file():
            raise ValueError('Missing required source: ' + name)
    qualifier_name = config['crosswalk_case'].removesuffix('_near')
    packet_path = attempt / 'qualifier-source-packet.json'
    if not packet_path.is_file():
        raise ValueError('Missing original qualifier source packet')
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text())
    qualifier_review = audit_qualifier(attempt, packet_path, case_id, qualifier_name,
        diagnostic=packet.get('diagnostic_fixture') is True)
    diagnostic = diagnose(attempt)
    sources = {name: sha(attempt / name) for name in source_names}
    poses = [json.loads(line) for line in (attempt / 'vehicle-poses.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    controls = [json.loads(line) for line in (attempt / 'control-intent.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    mapping = [json.loads(line) for line in (attempt / 'video_frames.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    channels = attempt / 'channels'
    if channels.exists():
        raise ValueError('Derived channels already exist')
    channels.mkdir()
    values = {
        'subject_vehicle_pose_and_extent': [p for p in poses],
        'control_intent': [c['applied_control'] for c in controls],
        'frame_join': [{'native_frame': m['native_frame'],
                        'camera_native_frames': m['camera_native_frames']} for m in mapping],
    }
    context_rows = [json.loads(line) for line in (attempt / 'authority-events.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(context_rows) != len(mapping):
        raise ValueError('Qualifier context frame count differs')
    values['authority_timeline'] = context_rows
    for name, items in values.items():
        with (channels / (name + '.jsonl')).open('x') as stream:
            for index, value in enumerate(items):
                stream.write(json.dumps({'time_s': mapping[index]['time_s'], 'value': value}) + '\n')
    context = {'crosswalk_extent': diagnostic['crosswalk_rect_xyxy_m'],
               'source_sha256': sources}
    (channels / 'crosswalk_extent.json').write_text(json.dumps(context, indent=2) + '\n')
    for name, digest in sources.items():
        if sha(attempt / name) != digest:
            raise ValueError('Finalizer changed original source: ' + name)
    measurement = measure_crosswalk_position(diagnostic, {name: sources[name] for name in
                                  ('vehicle-poses.jsonl', 'crosswalk-inventory.json',
                                   'crosswalk-source-review.json')})
    body_gap = measurement['value']['minimum_body_gap_m']
    expected = {'controlled_1': 12.0, 'controlled_2': 3.0,
                'boundary_20ft': 6.096, 'stop_near': 3.0, 'stand_near': 3.0, 'traffic_conflict_near': 3.0, 'law_compliance_near': 3.0, 'police_direction_near': 3.0, 'device_direction_near': 3.0}[config['crosswalk_case']]
    observed_halt = bool(diagnostic['halt_proxy_spans'])
    result = {'case_id': case_id,
              'measured_values': {'crosswalk_distance': measurement['value'],
                                  'engineering_action': diagnostic['engineering_action']},
              'target_checks': [{'target': 'observed stopped body gap to marked crosswalk',
                                 'requested': expected, 'measured': body_gap,
                                 'method': 'minimum original body polygon gap during sampled halt',
                                 'tolerance': 1.0, 'matched': abs(expected-body_gap) <= 1.0,
                                 'physical_cause_confirmed': False,
                                 'cause_evidence': list(sources)}],
              'setup_confirmed': False, 'behavior_attempted': observed_halt,
              'maneuver_completed': False,
              'termination_reason': 'Saved original-frame geometry measured; physical and marking review pending',
              'physical_failure_flags': ['actual_motion_marking_pixels_and_exceptions_unverified'],
              'trace_reference': 'trace.jsonl',
              'video_references': [name + '.mkv' for name in
                                   ('overview', 'approach', 'reference_corner', 'driver_reference')],
              'video_frame_map_reference': 'video_frames.jsonl',
              'recording_description': config['recording_description'],
              'recording_evidence': [{'name': item['name'], 'unit': item['unit'],
                  'reference': 'channels/' + item['name'] + ('.jsonl' if item in config['recording_description']['channels'] else '.json')}
                  for item in config['recording_description']['channels'] +
                              config['recording_description']['context_inputs']],
              'realized_observables': {'minimum_body_gap_m': {'value': body_gap,
                  'unit': 'm', 'method': 'minimum sampled halt body polygon gap',
                  'time_window': 'all sampled halted frames', 'statistic': 'min',
                  'reference': 'channels/subject_vehicle_pose_and_extent.jsonl'}},
              'accepted': False, 'legal_verdict_claimed': False}
    write_result(attempt, result)
    report = {'format': 'c229397-saved-delivery-measurements-v1', 'case_id': case_id,
              'measurements': {'crosswalk_position': measurement,
                  'qualifier_context': measure_qualifier_context(qualifier_review,
                      {name: sources[name] for name in ('authority-events.jsonl',
                       'qualifier-source-packet.json')})},
              'diagnostic': diagnostic, 'qualifier_source_review': qualifier_review,
              'source_sha256': sources,
              'physical_acceptance_claimed': False, 'legal_verdict_claimed': False}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
    return report


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--attempt', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(finalize(args.attempt, args.output), sort_keys=True))

"""Native acquisition helpers for exact crosswalk qualification variants.

The helpers record actor and device state. Their presence never decides whether
the statutory exception applies; authority and necessity are reviewed later.
"""
import json


QUALIFIERS = {
    'traffic_conflict_near': 'traffic_conflict',
    'law_compliance_near': 'law_compliance',
    'police_direction_near': 'police_direction',
    'device_direction_near': 'device_direction',
}


def spawn_traffic_actor(world, carla, owned):
    blueprints = sorted(world.get_blueprint_library().filter('vehicle.*'), key=lambda item: item.id)
    if len(blueprints) < 2:
        raise RuntimeError('Second Native traffic vehicle blueprint unavailable')
    blueprint = blueprints[1]
    blueprint.set_attribute('role_name', 'c229397_traffic_context')
    actor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, carla.Transform(
        carla.Location(x=-16.0, y=-1.75, z=8.8), carla.Rotation(yaw=0)))
    owned.append(actor)
    return actor


def traffic_command(actor, index, carla):
    command = {'throttle': .18 if index < 260 else 0.0,
               'brake': 0.0 if index < 260 else .7, 'hand_brake': False}
    actor.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(**command, steer=0))
    return command


def traffic_row(actor, index, native_frame, elapsed, command):
    transform = actor.get_transform()
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    extent = actor.bounding_box.extent
    return {'video_frame': index, 'native_frame': native_frame, 'time_s': elapsed,
            'actor_id': actor.id, 'blueprint_id': actor.type_id,
            'vehicle_xy_m': [transform.location.x, transform.location.y],
            'yaw_deg': transform.rotation.yaw,
            'bbox_half_length_m': extent.x, 'bbox_half_width_m': extent.y,
            'speed_mps': (velocity.x**2 + velocity.y**2 + velocity.z**2)**.5,
            'applied_control': command}


def find_device(world):
    actors = [actor for actor in world.get_actors().filter('traffic.traffic_light*')]
    near = [actor for actor in actors if
            -12 <= actor.get_transform().location.x <= 12 and
            -10 <= actor.get_transform().location.y <= 4]
    return sorted(near, key=lambda actor: actor.id)[0] if near else None


def device_row(device, index, native_frame, elapsed):
    if device is None:
        return {'video_frame': index, 'native_frame': native_frame, 'time_s': elapsed,
                'device_present': False, 'device_id': None, 'state': None,
                'source_status': 'Native device unavailable; direction unresolved'}
    transform = device.get_transform()
    return {'video_frame': index, 'native_frame': native_frame, 'time_s': elapsed,
            'device_present': True, 'device_id': device.id,
            'type_id': device.type_id, 'state': str(device.get_state()),
            'location_xyz_m': [transform.location.x, transform.location.y, transform.location.z],
            'source_status': 'Native device state only; authority and applicability unresolved'}


def spawn_direction_participant(world, carla, owned):
    """Place a visible candidate participant; police authority is never inferred."""
    blueprints = sorted(world.get_blueprint_library().filter('walker.pedestrian.*'),
                        key=lambda item: item.id)
    if not blueprints:
        raise RuntimeError('Native direction-participant blueprint unavailable')
    blueprint = blueprints[0]
    actor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, carla.Transform(
        carla.Location(x=-2.0, y=0.0, z=8.8), carla.Rotation(yaw=-90)))
    owned.append(actor)
    return actor


def authority_row(participant, index, native_frame, elapsed, qualifier):
    row = {'video_frame': index, 'native_frame': native_frame, 'time_s': elapsed,
           'qualifier': qualifier, 'authority_status': 'unverified',
           'direction_status': 'requires independent original source'}
    if participant is not None:
        transform = participant.get_transform()
        row['candidate_participant_id'] = participant.id
        row['candidate_participant_xyz_m'] = [transform.location.x,
                                               transform.location.y,
                                               transform.location.z]
    else:
        row['candidate_participant_id'] = None
    return row


def write_context_manifest(path, case, device):
    value = {'format': 'c229397-native-qualifier-context-v1', 'qualifier': QUALIFIERS[case],
             'case_suffix': case, 'traffic_actor_requested': case == 'traffic_conflict_near',
             'device_requested': case == 'device_direction_near',
             'device_actor_found': device is not None,
             'law_instruction_source_required': case == 'law_compliance_near',
             'officer_authority_source_required': case == 'police_direction_near',
             'authority_and_necessity_unresolved': True,
             'physical_acceptance_claimed': False, 'legal_verdict_claimed': False}
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')
    return value
